company.name: 3Air
company.shortDescription: 3Air is the world's first blockchain platform that helps individuals and businesses thrive on WEB3 with broadband internet.
company.description:
3air is a broadband connectivity and digital infrastructure company focused on expanding high-speed internet access across underserved regions in Africa. The company combines telecommunications infrastructure with blockchain-enabled digital services to help bridge the digital divide in emerging markets.

Its core offering is based on proprietary wireless technology capable of delivering optics-grade broadband “through the air,” enabling high-speed connectivity without relying heavily on traditional fiber deployment.
